Num.14.5.kjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

Num.27.18.bsb: And the LORD replied to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.
Num.27.18.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

Num.27.19.bsb: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, and commission him in their sight.
Num.27.19.kjv: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

Num.27.20.bsb: Confer on him some of your authority, so that the whole congregation of Israel will obey him.
Num.27.20.kjv: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

Num.27.21.bsb: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who will seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim. At his command, he and all the Israelites with him—the entire congregation—will go out and come in.”
Num.27.21.kjv: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the Lord: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

Num.27.22.bsb: Moses did as the LORD had commanded him. He took Joshua, had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation,
Num.27.22.kjv: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

Num.27.23.bsb: and laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD had instructed through Moses.
Num.27.23.kjv: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

Num.35.12.bsb: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.
Num.35.12.kjv: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

Num.35.24.bsb: then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
Num.35.24.kjv: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

Num.35.25.bsb: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
Num.35.25.kjv: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

Num.11.18.bsb: And say to the people: Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you will eat meat, because you have cried out in the hearing of the LORD, saying: ‘Who will feed us meat? For we were better off in Egypt!’ Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
Num.11.18.kjv: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the Lord will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

Num.16.25.bsb: So Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.
Num.16.25.kjv: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

Num.22.4.bsb: So the Moabites said to the elders of Midian, “This horde will devour everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field.” Since Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time,
Num.22.4.kjv: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.

Num.22.7.bsb: The elders of Moab and Midian departed with the fees for divination in hand. They came to Balaam and relayed to him the words of Balak.
Num.22.7.kjv: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

Num.1.4.bsb: And one man from each tribe, the head of each family, must be there with you.
Num.1.4.kjv: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

Num.1.5.bsb: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: From the tribe of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
Num.1.5.kjv: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

Num.1.6.bsb: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
Num.1.6.kjv: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

Num.1.7.bsb: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
Num.1.7.kjv: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

Num.1.8.bsb: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
Num.1.8.kjv: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

Num.1.9.bsb: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
Num.1.9.kjv: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

Num.1.10.bsb: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud, and from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
Num.1.10.kjv: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

Num.1.11.bsb: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
Num.1.11.kjv: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

Num.7.10.kjv: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.

Num.7.11.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

Num.7.18.kjv: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:

Num.7.84.bsb: So these were the offerings from the leaders of Israel for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold dishes.
Num.7.84.kjv: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

Num.10.4.kjv: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

Num.16.2.bsb: a rebellion against Moses, along with 250 men of Israel renowned as leaders of the congregation and representatives in the assembly.

Num.17.2.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man’s name upon his rod.

Num.17.6.kjv: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

Num.34.18.kjv: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

Num.34.19.bsb: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah;
Num.34.19.kjv: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

Num.34.20.bsb: Shemuel son of Ammihud from the tribe of Simeon;

Num.34.21.kjv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

Num.34.22.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

Num.34.23.bsb: Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;
Num.34.23.kjv: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

Num.34.24.bsb: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim;
Num.34.24.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

Num.34.25.bsb: Eli-zaphan son of Parnach, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun;
Num.34.25.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

Num.34.26.bsb: Paltiel son of Azzan, a leader from the tribe of Issachar;
Num.34.26.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

Num.34.27.bsb: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;
Num.34.27.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

Num.34.28.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

Num.34.29.kjv: These are they whom the Lord commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

Num.36.1.kjv: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

Num.14.26.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
Num.14.26.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

Num.14.28.bsb: So tell them: As surely as I live, declares the LORD, I will do to you exactly as I heard you say.
Num.14.28.kjv: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

Num.14.29.bsb: Your bodies will fall in this wilderness—all who were numbered in the census, everyone twenty years of age or older—because you have grumbled against Me.
Num.14.29.kjv: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

Num.14.30.bsb: Surely none of you will enter the land in which I swore to settle you, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
Num.14.30.kjv: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

Num.14.31.bsb: But I will bring your children, whom you said would become plunder, into the land you have rejected—and they will enjoy it.
Num.14.31.kjv: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

Num.14.32.bsb: As for you, however, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.
Num.14.32.kjv: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

Num.14.34.bsb: In keeping with the forty days you spied out the land, you shall bear your guilt forty years—a year for each day—and you will experience My alienation.
Num.14.34.kjv: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

Num.14.35.bsb: I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this entire wicked congregation, which has conspired against Me. They will meet their end in the wilderness, and there they will die.”
Num.14.35.kjv: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

Num.14.36.bsb: So the men Moses had sent to spy out the land, who had returned and made the whole congregation grumble against him by bringing out a bad report about the land—
Num.14.36.kjv: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

Num.14.37.bsb: those men who had brought out the bad report about the land—were struck down by a plague before the LORD.
Num.14.37.kjv: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.

Num.14.38.bsb: Of those men who had gone to spy out the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh remained alive.
Num.14.38.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.

Num.14.39.bsb: And when Moses relayed these words to all the Israelites, the people mourned bitterly.
Num.14.39.kjv: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

Num.14.40.bsb: Early the next morning they got up and went up toward the ridge of the hill country. “We have indeed sinned,” they said, “but we will go to the place the LORD has promised.”
Num.14.40.kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the Lord hath promised: for we have sinned.

Num.14.41.bsb: But Moses said, “Why are you transgressing the commandment of the LORD? This will not succeed!
Num.14.41.kjv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the Lord? but it shall not prosper.

Num.14.42.bsb: Do not go up, lest you be struck down by your enemies, because the LORD is not among you.
Num.14.42.kjv: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

Num.14.44.bsb: But they dared to go up to the ridge of the hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the covenant of the LORD moved from the camp.
Num.14.44.kjv: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

Num.14.45.bsb: Then the Amalekites and Canaanites who lived in that part of the hill country came down, attacked them, and routed them all the way to Hormah.
Num.14.45.kjv: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

Num.5.11.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses,
Num.5.11.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Num.5.12.bsb: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him
Num.5.12.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

Num.5.13.bsb: by sleeping with another man, and it is concealed from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she was not caught in the act),
Num.5.13.kjv: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;

Num.5.29.bsb: This is the law of jealousy when a wife goes astray and defiles herself while under her husband’s authority,
Num.5.29.kjv: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;

Num.5.30.bsb: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over a husband and he suspects his wife. He is to have the woman stand before the LORD, and the priest is to apply to her this entire law.
Num.5.30.kjv: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the Lord, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

Num.5.31.bsb: The husband will be free from guilt, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.”
Num.5.31.kjv: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

Num.25.1.bsb: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab,
Num.25.1.kjv: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.

Num.25.2.bsb: who also invited them to the sacrifices for their gods. And the people ate and bowed down to these gods.
Num.25.2.kjv: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

Num.33.52.bsb: you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land, destroy all their carved images and cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
Num.33.52.kjv: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

Num.33.4.kjv: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.

Num.15.22.bsb: Now if you stray unintentionally and do not obey all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses—
Num.15.22.kjv: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord hath spoken unto Moses,

Num.15.23.bsb: all that the LORD has commanded you through Moses from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come—
Num.15.23.kjv: Even all that the Lord hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;

Num.15.24.bsb: and if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation, then the whole congregation is to prepare one young bull as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD, with its grain offering and drink offering according to the regulation, and one male goat as a sin offering.
Num.15.24.kjv: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the Lord, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

Num.15.25.bsb: The priest is to make atonement for the whole congregation of Israel, so that they may be forgiven; for the sin was unintentional and they have brought to the LORD a food offering and a sin offering, presented before the LORD for their unintentional sin.
Num.15.25.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their ignorance:

Num.15.26.bsb: Then the whole congregation of Israel and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, since it happened to all the people unintentionally.
Num.15.26.kjv: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

Num.15.27.bsb: Also, if one person sins unintentionally, he is to present a year-old female goat as a sin offering.
Num.15.27.kjv: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

Num.15.28.bsb: And the priest shall make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the person who erred by sinning unintentionally; and when atonement has been made for him, he will be forgiven.
Num.15.28.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the Lord, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

Num.15.29.bsb: You shall have the same law for the one who acts in error, whether he is a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.
Num.15.29.kjv: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

Num.15.38.bsb: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that throughout the generations to come they are to make for themselves tassels for the corners of their garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.
Num.15.38.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

Num.15.39.bsb: These will serve as tassels for you to look at, so that you may remember all the commandments of the LORD, that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by following your own heart and your own eyes.
Num.15.39.kjv: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

Num.12.12.bsb: Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

Num.14.22.bsb: not one of the men who have seen My glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness—yet have tested Me and disobeyed Me these ten times—

Num.14.23.bsb: not one will ever see the land that I swore to give their fathers. None of those who have treated Me with contempt will see it.

Num.25.9.bsb: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.

Num.26.63.bsb: These were the ones numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.
Num.26.63.kjv: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

Num.26.64.bsb: Among all these, however, there was not one who had been numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Wilderness of Sinai.
Num.26.64.kjv: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

Num.26.65.bsb: For the LORD had told them that they would surely die in the wilderness. Not one was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
Num.26.65.kjv: For the Lord had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

Num.1.47.bsb: The Levites, however, were not numbered along with them by the tribe of their fathers.
Num.1.47.kjv: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

Num.1.48.bsb: For the LORD had said to Moses:
Num.1.48.kjv: For the Lord had spoken unto Moses, saying,

Num.1.49.bsb: “Do not number the tribe of Levi in the census with the other Israelites.
Num.1.49.kjv: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

Num.1.50.bsb: Instead, you are to appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, all its furnishings, and everything in it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, care for it, and camp around it.
Num.1.50.kjv: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

Num.1.51.bsb: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever it is to be pitched, the Levites are to set it up. Any outsider who goes near it must be put to death.
Num.1.51.kjv: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

Num.1.52.bsb: The Israelites are to camp by their divisions, each man in his own camp and under his own standard.
Num.1.52.kjv: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

Num.1.53.bsb: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it, so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel. So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
Num.1.53.kjv: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

Num.1.54.bsb: Thus the Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Num.1.54.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.

Num.3.6.bsb: “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.
Num.3.6.kjv: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

Num.3.7.bsb: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, attending to the service of the tabernacle.
Num.3.7.kjv: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

Num.3.8.bsb: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.
Num.3.8.kjv: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

Num.3.9.bsb: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they have been given exclusively to him from among the Israelites.
Num.3.9.kjv: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.

Num.3.10.bsb: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood; but any outsider who approaches the tabernacle must be put to death.”
Num.3.10.kjv: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

Num.3.11.bsb: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
Num.3.11.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Num.3.12.bsb: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb. The Levites belong to Me,
Num.3.12.kjv: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

Num.3.13.bsb: for all the firstborn are Mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They are Mine; I am the LORD.”
Num.3.13.kjv: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the Lord.

Num.3.14.bsb: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying,
Num.3.14.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

Num.3.15.bsb: “Number the Levites by their families and clans. You are to count every male a month old or more.”
Num.3.15.kjv: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

Num.3.16.bsb: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he had been commanded.
Num.3.16.kjv: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.

Num.16.9.bsb: Is it not enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel and brought you near to Himself to perform the work at the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them?
Num.16.9.kjv: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

Num.26.57.bsb: Now these were the Levites numbered by their clans: The Gershonite clan from Gershon, the Kohathite clan from Kohath, and the Merarite clan from Merari.
Num.26.57.kjv: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

Num.26.58.bsb: These were the families of the Levites: The Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, and the Korahite clan. Now Kohath was the father of Amram,
Num.26.58.kjv: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.

Num.26.59.bsb: and Amram’s wife was named Jochebed. She was also a daughter of Levi, born to Levi in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam.
Num.26.59.kjv: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

Num.26.60.bsb: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar were born to Aaron,
Num.26.60.kjv: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

Num.26.61.bsb: but Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.
Num.26.61.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.

Num.26.62.bsb: The registration of the Levites totaled 23,000, every male a month old or more; they were not numbered among the other Israelites, because no inheritance was given to them among the Israelites.
Num.26.62.kjv: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

Num.3.41.bsb: You are to take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites.”
Num.3.41.kjv: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the Lord) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

Num.3.42.bsb: So Moses numbered all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the LORD had commanded him.
Num.3.42.kjv: And Moses numbered, as the Lord commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

Num.3.43.bsb: The total number of the firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.
Num.3.43.kjv: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

Num.3.44.bsb: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
Num.3.44.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Num.3.45.bsb: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites belong to Me; I am the LORD.
Num.3.45.kjv: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the Lord.

Num.8.14.bsb: In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.
Num.8.14.kjv: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

Num.8.16.bsb: For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.
Num.8.16.kjv: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

Num.8.17.bsb: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.
Num.8.17.kjv: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

Num.8.18.bsb: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.
Num.8.18.kjv: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

Num.18.6.bsb: Behold, I Myself have selected your fellow Levites from the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to perform the service for the Tent of Meeting.
Num.18.6.kjv: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the Lord, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

Num.8.8.bsb: Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
Num.8.8.kjv: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

Num.8.9.bsb: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.
Num.8.9.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

Num.8.10.bsb: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.
Num.8.10.kjv: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

Num.8.11.bsb: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.
Num.8.11.kjv: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the Lord.

Num.8.12.bsb: And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.
Num.8.12.kjv: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the Lord, to make an atonement for the Levites.

Num.8.13.bsb: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.
Num.8.13.kjv: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the Lord.

Num.8.15.bsb: After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
Num.8.15.kjv: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

Num.8.20.bsb: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD had commanded Moses they should do.
Num.8.20.kjv: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

Num.8.21.bsb: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.
Num.8.21.kjv: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the Lord; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

Num.4.19.bsb: In order that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go in and assign each man his task and what he is to carry.
Num.4.19.kjv: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

Num.4.20.bsb: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.”
Num.4.20.kjv: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

Num.3.17.bsb: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Num.3.17.kjv: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

Num.3.18.bsb: These were the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
Num.3.18.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.

Num.3.19.bsb: The sons of Kohath by their clans were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Num.3.19.kjv: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

Num.3.20.bsb: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites, according to their families.
Num.3.20.kjv: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

Num.3.21.bsb: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan; these were the Gershonite clans.
Num.3.21.kjv: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

Num.3.22.bsb: The number of all the males a month old or more was 7,500.
Num.3.22.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

Num.3.23.bsb: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle,
Num.3.23.kjv: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.

Num.3.24.bsb: and the leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
Num.3.24.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

Num.3.25.bsb: The duties of the Gershonites at the Tent of Meeting were the tabernacle and tent, its covering, the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
Num.3.25.kjv: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

Num.3.26.bsb: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, and the cords—all the service for these items.
Num.3.26.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

Num.4.23.bsb: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
Num.4.23.kjv: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

Num.4.24.bsb: This is the service of the Gershonite clans regarding work and transport:
Num.4.24.kjv: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

Num.4.25.bsb: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
Num.4.25.kjv: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

Num.4.26.bsb: the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtains for the entrance at the gate of the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, along with their ropes and all the equipment for their service. The Gershonites will do all that needs to be done with these items.
Num.4.26.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

Num.10.17.bsb: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites set out, transporting it.
Num.10.17.kjv: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

Num.4.28.bsb: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting, and their duties shall be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
Num.4.28.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

Num.3.27.bsb: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.
Num.3.27.kjv: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

Num.4.18.bsb: “Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.
Num.4.18.kjv: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

Num.3.38.bsb: Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, before the Tent of Meeting. They were to perform the duties of the sanctuary as a service on behalf of the Israelites; but any outsider who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.
Num.3.38.kjv: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

Num.17.1.bsb: And the LORD said to Moses,
Num.17.1.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Num.17.3.bsb: and write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi, because there must be one staff for the head of each tribe.
Num.17.3.kjv: And thou shalt write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.

Num.17.4.bsb: Place the staffs in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony, where I meet with you.
Num.17.4.kjv: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

Num.17.8.bsb: The next day Moses entered the Tent of the Testimony and saw that Aaron’s staff, representing the house of Levi, had sprouted, put forth buds, blossomed, and produced almonds.
Num.17.8.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

Num.3.29.bsb: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,
Num.3.29.kjv: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.

Num.3.30.bsb: and the leader of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
Num.3.30.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

Num.3.31.bsb: Their duties were the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used with them, and the curtain—all the service for these items.
Num.3.31.kjv: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

Num.3.32.bsb: The chief of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest; he oversaw those responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
Num.3.32.kjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

Num.4.2.bsb: “Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families,
Num.4.2.kjv: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

Num.4.3.bsb: men from thirty to fifty years old—everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
Num.4.3.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

Num.4.4.bsb: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.
Num.4.4.kjv: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:

Num.4.5.bsb: Whenever the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons are to go in, take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.
Num.4.5.kjv: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:

Num.4.6.bsb: They are to place over this a covering of fine leather, spread a solid blue cloth over it, and insert its poles.
Num.4.6.kjv: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

Num.4.7.bsb: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.
Num.4.7.kjv: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

Num.4.8.bsb: And they shall spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover them with fine leather, and insert the poles.
Num.4.8.kjv: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

Num.4.9.bsb: They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand used for light, together with its lamps, wick trimmers, and trays, as well as the jars of oil with which to supply it.
Num.4.9.kjv: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

Num.4.10.bsb: Then they shall wrap it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and put it on the carrying frame.
Num.4.10.kjv: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.

Num.4.11.bsb: Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth, cover it with fine leather, and insert the poles.
Num.4.11.kjv: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

Num.4.13.bsb: Then they shall remove the ashes from the bronze altar, spread a purple cloth over it,
Num.4.13.kjv: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

Num.4.14.bsb: and place on it all the vessels used to serve there: the firepans, meat forks, shovels, and sprinkling bowls—all the equipment of the altar. They are to spread over it a covering of fine leather and insert the poles.
Num.4.14.kjv: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.

Num.4.15.bsb: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy objects, or they will die. These are the transportation duties of the Kohathites regarding the Tent of Meeting.
Num.4.15.kjv: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

Num.3.33.bsb: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.
Num.3.33.kjv: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

Num.3.34.bsb: The number of all the males a month old or more was 6,200.
Num.3.34.kjv: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.

Num.3.35.bsb: The leader of the families of the Merarites was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
Num.3.35.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

Num.3.36.bsb: The duties assigned to the sons of Merari were the tabernacle’s frames, crossbars, posts, bases, and all its equipment—all the service for these items,
Num.3.36.kjv: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,

Num.3.37.bsb: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes.
Num.3.37.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

Num.4.31.bsb: This is the duty for all their service at the Tent of Meeting: to carry the frames of the tabernacle with its crossbars, posts, and bases,
Num.4.31.kjv: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

Num.4.32.bsb: and the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes, including all their equipment and everything related to their use. You shall assign by name the items that they are responsible to carry.
Num.4.32.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

Num.4.33.bsb: This is the service of the Merarite clans according to all their work at the Tent of Meeting, under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.”
Num.4.33.kjv: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

Num.7.8.bsb: and he gave the Merarites four carts and eight oxen, as their service required, all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
Num.7.8.kjv: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

Num.2.17.bsb: In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites. They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard.
Num.2.17.kjv: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.

Num.4.30.bsb: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting.
Num.4.30.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

Num.4.47.bsb: from thirty to fifty years old who came to do the work of serving and carrying the Tent of Meeting.
Num.4.47.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,

Num.8.23.bsb: And the LORD said to Moses,
Num.8.23.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Num.8.24.bsb: “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
Num.8.24.kjv: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

Num.8.25.bsb: But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.
Num.8.25.kjv: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:

Num.8.26.bsb: After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.”
Num.8.26.kjv: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

Num.4.1.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
Num.4.1.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

Num.4.17.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
Num.4.17.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

Num.4.21.bsb: And the LORD said to Moses,
Num.4.21.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Num.4.22.bsb: “Take a census of the Gershonites as well, by their families and clans,
Num.4.22.kjv: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

Num.4.27.bsb: All the service of the Gershonites—all their transport duties and other work—is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.
Num.4.27.kjv: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

Num.4.29.bsb: As for the sons of Merari, you are to number them by their clans and families,
Num.4.29.kjv: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;

Num.4.34.bsb: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation numbered the Kohathites by their clans and families,
Num.4.34.kjv: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

Num.4.35.bsb: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
Num.4.35.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:

Num.4.36.bsb: And those numbered by their clans totaled 2,750.
Num.4.36.kjv: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

Num.4.37.bsb: These were counted from the Kohathite clans, everyone who could serve at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron numbered them according to the command of the LORD through Moses.
Num.4.37.kjv: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

Num.4.38.bsb: Then the Gershonites were numbered by their clans and families,
Num.4.38.kjv: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,

Num.4.39.bsb: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
Num.4.39.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

Num.4.40.bsb: And those numbered by their clans and families totaled 2,630.
Num.4.40.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

Num.4.41.bsb: These were counted from the Gershonite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the LORD’s command.
Num.4.41.kjv: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord.

Num.4.42.bsb: And the Merarites were numbered by their clans and families,
Num.4.42.kjv: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,

Num.4.43.bsb: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
Num.4.43.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

Num.4.44.bsb: The men registered by their clans numbered 3,200.
Num.4.44.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

Num.4.45.bsb: These were counted from the Merarite clans, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the LORD’s command through Moses.
Num.4.45.kjv: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

Num.4.46.bsb: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel numbered by their clans and families all the Levites
Num.4.46.kjv: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

Num.4.48.bsb: And the number of men was 8,580.
Num.4.48.kjv: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.

Num.4.49.bsb: At the LORD’s command through Moses they were numbered, and each one was assigned his work and burden, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Num.4.49.kjv: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the Lord commanded Moses.

Num.18.3.bsb: And they shall attend to your duties and to all the duties of the Tent; but they must not come near to the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar, or both they and you will die.
Num.18.3.kjv: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

Num.18.4.bsb: They are to join you and attend to the duties of the Tent of Meeting, doing all the work at the Tent; but no outsider may come near you.
Num.18.4.kjv: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

Num.35.2.bsb: “Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.
Num.35.2.kjv: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

Num.35.3.bsb: The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.
Num.35.3.kjv: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

Num.35.4.bsb: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.
Num.35.4.kjv: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

Num.35.5.bsb: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.
Num.35.5.kjv: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

Num.35.6.bsb: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.
Num.35.6.kjv: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

Num.35.7.bsb: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.
Num.35.7.kjv: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.

Num.35.8.bsb: The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.”
Num.35.8.kjv: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

Num.18.24.bsb: For I have given to the Levites as their inheritance the tithe that the Israelites present to the LORD as a contribution. That is why I told them that they would not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.”
Num.18.24.kjv: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the Lord, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

Num.18.26.bsb: “Speak to the Levites and tell them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe that I have given you as your inheritance, you must present part of it as an offering to the LORD—a tithe of the tithe.
Num.18.26.kjv: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the Lord, even a tenth part of the tithe.

Num.18.27.bsb: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.
Num.18.27.kjv: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

Num.18.28.bsb: So you are to present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites, and from these you are to give the LORD’s offering to Aaron the priest.
Num.18.28.kjv: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the Lord of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the Lord’s heave offering to Aaron the priest.

Num.18.29.bsb: You must present the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift, the holiest part of it.’
Num.18.29.kjv: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the Lord, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

Num.18.30.bsb: Therefore say to the Levites, ‘When you have presented the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.
Num.18.30.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

Num.18.31.bsb: And you and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere; it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting.
Num.18.31.kjv: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

Num.18.32.bsb: Once you have presented the best part of it, you will not incur guilt because of it. But you must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, or else you will die.’”
Num.18.32.kjv: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

Num.31.30.bsb: From the Israelites’ half, take one out of every fifty, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep, or other animals, and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.”
Num.31.30.kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.

Num.31.42.bsb: From the Israelites’ half, which Moses had set apart from the men who had gone to war,
Num.31.42.kjv: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

Num.31.43.bsb: this half belonged to the congregation: 337,500 sheep,
Num.31.43.kjv: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

Num.31.44.kjv: And thirty and six thousand beeves,

Num.31.45.kjv: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,

Num.31.47.bsb: From the Israelites’ half, Moses took one out of every fifty persons and animals and gave them to the Levites who kept charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, as the LORD had commanded him.
Num.31.47.kjv: Even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

Num.2.33.bsb: But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Num.2.33.kjv: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.

Num.3.39.bsb: The total number of Levites that Moses and Aaron counted by their clans at the LORD’s command, including all the males a month old or more, was 22,000.
Num.3.39.kjv: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

Num.31.48.bsb: Then the officers who were over the units of the army—the commanders of thousands and of hundreds—approached Moses
Num.31.48.kjv: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:

Num.31.49.bsb: and said, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one of us is missing.
Num.31.49.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

Num.31.50.bsb: So we have brought to the LORD an offering of the gold articles each man acquired—armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces—to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.”
Num.31.50.kjv: We have therefore brought an oblation for the Lord, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the Lord.

Num.31.51.bsb: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received from them all the articles made out of gold.
Num.31.51.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

Num.31.52.bsb: All the gold that the commanders of thousands and of hundreds presented as an offering to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.
Num.31.52.kjv: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the Lord, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

Num.31.53.bsb: Each of the soldiers had taken plunder for himself.
Num.31.53.kjv: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

Num.31.54.bsb: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.
Num.31.54.kjv: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord.

Num.36.8.bsb: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.
Num.36.8.kjv: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

Num.20.29.bsb: When the whole congregation saw that Aaron had died, the entire house of Israel mourned for him thirty days.
Num.20.29.kjv: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

Num.19.14.bsb: This is the law when a person dies in a tent: Everyone who enters the tent and everyone already in the tent will be unclean for seven days,
Num.19.14.kjv: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

Num.19.15.bsb: and any open container without a lid fastened on it is unclean.
Num.19.15.kjv: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

Num.19.16.bsb: Anyone in the open field who touches someone who has been killed by the sword or has died of natural causes, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.
Num.19.16.kjv: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

Num.6.1.bsb: And the LORD said to Moses,
Num.6.1.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Num.6.21.bsb: This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to whatever else he can afford; he must fulfill whatever vow he makes, according to the law of his separation.”
Num.6.21.kjv: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the Lord for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

Num.27.1.bsb: Now the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. These were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. They approached
Num.27.1.kjv: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

Num.27.3.bsb: “Our father died in the wilderness, but he was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD. Instead, he died because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
Num.27.3.kjv: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

Num.27.4.bsb: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons? Give us property among our father’s brothers.”
Num.27.4.kjv: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

Num.27.5.bsb: So Moses brought their case before the LORD,
Num.27.5.kjv: And Moses brought their cause before the Lord.

Num.16.15.bsb: Then Moses became very angry and said to the LORD, “Do not regard their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them or mistreated a single one of them.”
Num.16.15.kjv: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the Lord, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

Num.22.6.bsb: So please come now and put a curse on this people, because they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I may be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land; for I know that those you bless are blessed, and those you curse are cursed.”
Num.22.6.kjv: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

Num.22.8.bsb: “Spend the night here,” Balaam replied, “and I will give you the answer that the LORD speaks to me.” So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.
Num.22.8.kjv: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the Lord shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

Num.22.9.bsb: Then God came to Balaam and asked, “Who are these men with you?”
Num.22.9.kjv: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?

Num.22.10.bsb: And Balaam said to God, “Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:
Num.22.10.kjv: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,

Num.22.11.bsb: ‘Behold, a people has come out of Egypt, and they cover the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps I may be able to fight against them and drive them away.’”
Num.22.11.kjv: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

Num.11.11.bsb: So Moses asked the LORD, “Why have You brought this trouble on Your servant? Why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid upon me the burden of all these people?
Num.11.11.kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

Num.11.12.bsb: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth, so that You should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries an infant,’ to the land that You swore to give their fathers?
Num.11.12.kjv: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

Num.11.13.bsb: Where can I get meat for all these people? For they keep crying out to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
Num.11.13.kjv: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

Num.11.14.bsb: I cannot carry all these people by myself; it is too burdensome for me.
Num.11.14.kjv: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

Num.11.19.bsb: You will eat it not for one or two days, nor for five or ten or twenty days,
Num.11.19.kjv: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

Num.11.20.bsb: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous—because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have cried out before Him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt?’”
Num.11.20.kjv: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the Lord which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

Num.11.21.bsb: But Moses replied, “Here I am among 600,000 men on foot, yet You say, ‘I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.’
Num.11.21.kjv: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

Num.11.22.bsb: If all our flocks and herds were slaughtered for them, would they have enough? Or if all the fish in the sea were caught for them, would they have enough?”
Num.11.22.kjv: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

Num.11.26.bsb: Two men, however, had remained in the camp—one named Eldad and the other Medad—and the Spirit rested on them. They were among those listed, but they had not gone out to the tent, and they prophesied in the camp.
Num.11.26.kjv: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

Num.11.27.bsb: A young man ran and reported to Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.”
Num.11.27.kjv: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

Num.11.35.bsb: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people moved on to Hazeroth, where they remained for some time.
Num.11.35.kjv: And the people journeyed from Kibroth–hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

Num.5.5.bsb: And the LORD said to Moses,
Num.5.5.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

Num.5.6.bsb: “Tell the Israelites that when a man or woman acts unfaithfully against the LORD by committing any sin against another, that person is guilty
Num.5.6.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the Lord, and that person be guilty;

Num.5.7.bsb: and must confess the sin he has committed. He must make full restitution, add a fifth to its value, and give all this to the one he has wronged.
Num.5.7.kjv: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

Num.14.15.bsb: If You kill this people as one man, the nations who have heard of Your fame will say,
Num.14.15.kjv: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

Num.14.16.bsb: ‘Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
Num.14.16.kjv: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

Num.14.17.bsb: So now I pray, may the power of my Lord be magnified, just as You have declared:
Num.14.17.kjv: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
